items.headline: 115 passengers taken ill after eating contaminated food on Chennai-Mangaluru train
items.blurb: One hundred fifteen passengers fell ill after eating contaminated meals on a Chennai–Mangaluru train, with hospitals treating food-poisoning cases in both cities.
items.why_channel: Mass public-health scare on a Chennai–Mangaluru train — high saves and stranger-share potential.

items.headline: M'luru in the running for 50-acre cricket hub
items.blurb: Mangaluru Urban Development Authority and Karnataka State Cricket Association are evaluating government land parcels of about 25–50 acres, including sites near Kenjar, Gurupura bridge and New Mangaluru Port Authority, for a proposed cricket stadium.
items.why_channel: Large-scale sports infra with 25–50 acre sites near Kenjar and port — local jobs and land-use hook.

items.headline: 'Digital arrest' scam strips farmer of ₹1.31 cr
items.blurb: A 52-year-old farmer from Puttur lost ₹1.31 crore to fraudsters posing as Mumbai Police and ATS officers who claimed he was linked to terrorist money laundering.
items.why_channel: ₹1.31 cr digital-arrest scam in Puttur — accountability and personal fraud-stakes.

items.headline: DK child protection unit to probe sexual abuse charge against church priest
items.blurb: The Dakshina Kannada District Child Protection Unit is investigating allegations that a church priest sexually abused a minor girl.
items.why_channel: DK child-protection probe into priest abuse — women's safety and civic trust.

items.headline: AERA to hold tariff consultation for Mangaluru airport
items.blurb: The Airports Economic Regulatory Authority scheduled a stakeholders' meeting on October 15, 2026, on aeronautical tariffs for Mangaluru International Airport for the second control period 2024–2031.
items.why_channel: Actionable Oct 15 airport tariff hearing — money and travel impact for Mangaluru flyers.
